review_findings.finding: V1 divided shot time evenly inside beats instead of cutting at phrase/action/state changes.
review_findings.fix: V2R1 is rebuilt from Prosodic Atom boundaries and uses 200 shots with every review shot under 8 seconds.

review_findings.finding: V1 lacked spoken-text binding per shot.
review_findings.fix: Every V2R1 shot carries its spoken span and source atom IDs.

review_findings.finding: V1 had no EP005-level SFX authority.
review_findings.fix: Every shot now has a literal independent SFX cue plus bed/foreground/depth/LF design; music remains forbidden.

review_findings.finding: V1 overused Text Evidence (31 cards), risking documentary slide-show rhythm.
review_findings.fix: V2R1 keeps only 8 standalone evidence cards; 19 other textual moments are integrated into live/still plates so drama remains visually continuous.

review_findings.finding: V1 face rule was too strict and contradicted the current human policy.
review_findings.fix: Head visible is allowed; full face remains forbidden; partial face is allowed only when natural occlusion/covering prevents complete face geometry.

review_findings.finding: V1 had insufficient continuity architecture for ark/water/son/Nuh.
review_findings.fix: V2R1 defines continuity anchors: Nuh identity, son, wife, believers, ark stages, water escalation ladder, Judi, settlement, callback motifs.

review_findings.finding: V1 did not distinguish Quranic certainty from traditional reports/editorial visualization.
review_findings.fix: Each shot is tagged DIRECT_QURANIC / NARRATION_DIRECT / TRADITIONAL_REPORT_CAUTIOUS / SYMBOLIC_EDITORIAL / SERIES_CONTINUITY.

review_findings.finding: V1 flood spectacle risked spending its scale too early.
review_findings.fix: V2R1 uses a five-stage water escalation ladder and reserves mountain-wave scale for the proper climax.

review_findings.finding: V1 son climax was undercut by too few decision beats.
review_findings.fix: V2R1 turns S13 into a clear spatial and emotional sequence: sightline → mountain choice → call → reply → water wall → total occlusion.

review_findings.finding: V1 implied overly specific historical production design without a certainty policy.
review_findings.fix: World-building is ancient Near Eastern plausible but deliberately non-specific; no exact date, city, ship blueprint, or ethnic costume is asserted.

review_findings.finding: V1 ending was informative but not enough of a serial hook.
review_findings.fix: V2R1 ends with visual callbacks, expanding civilization, “من أشد منا قوة”, distant Hud teaser, and explicit next-episode end card.
